name: stripe_payments
description: Stripe payment data retrieval tool. Input: query_type (string, required) — one of: recent_payments, failed_charges, customers, subscriptions. limit (number, optional, default 10, max 25). Output: records (array of payment objects), query_type (string), total_returned (number), data_source (string), timestamp (ISO 8601 string). Connects directly to Stripe API. Returns live payment intent, charge failure, customer, and subscription data.

query_type.description: Type of Stripe data to retrieve. Accepted values: recent_payments, failed_charges, customers, subscriptions.

limit.description: Number of records to return. Defaults to 10. Maximum 25.
